summary.name: 逗逗AI (Doudou AI)
summary.one_liner: Doudou AI is a game companion that watches your PC game screen and talks with you by real-time voice while offering strategy help and companionship.
use_cases: get strategy hints while playing PC games
voice chat with an AI partner during gameplay
ask game-related questions with web search
AI reacts to important in-game moments
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Doudou AI (逗逗AI) as an AI game partner that uses VLM (vision-language model) technology to recognize the live game screen and flag important scenes to the user proactively. Users can hold real-time voice calls with the AI during play and ask game questions, which the AI answers using web search plus reasoning. It says the AI remembers interactions across different games and scenes, and offers several human-like personality companions. The page lists PC game examples such as Hollow Knight: Silksong, Hades II, Silent Hill f, Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, and ARC Raiders.
notable: Real-time screen recognition with proactive prompts for key scenes
Web search plus reasoning for game strategy questions
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; the directory listing tags it #free, which the page itself does not confirm
Only PC game examples are shown; other platforms are not mentioned
